one_line: Early 19th-century Bengali reformer, writer and Brahmo Sabha founder moving between Persianate learning and colonial Calcutta.

appearance.age_look: Early 50s, medium height, slightly stooped scholarly build with calm, deliberate movements.
appearance.face: Oval face, wheatish-brown Bengali complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard along the jawline, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with small round spectacles, default expression composed and quietly intense as if weighing arguments.
appearance.hair: Black hair just visible at the sides, combed back and tucked under a deep blue silk Bengali-style turban wrapped smoothly with a slightly conical crown and a narrow gold border at the edge.
appearance.costume: He wears a finely woven white cotton Bengali dhoti, pleated in front and wrapped to the ankles, paired with a long-sleeved off-white jama (Persian-style robe) that crosses and ties at the waist, its edges trimmed with a thin gold border; over this, a full-length sleeveless chadar-style shawl of rich dark indigo, draped from the left shoulder across the body and around the back, the shawl’s ends hanging neatly with a subtle woven stripe pattern in lighter blue; simple brown leather slippers, no bare feet, and a plain signet ring on his right hand for understated status.
appearance.signature: A rolled manuscript tied with a red ribbon held in his right hand, with a plain wooden walking stick in his left serving as a secondary prop but always kept simple and unornamented.

ref_desc: Rammohun Roy appears as a thoughtful middle-aged Bengali man with a deep blue silk turban, oval wheatish face and spectacles, wearing a white dhoti, off-white jama, dark indigo shawl with gold trim, holding a rolled manuscript and simple walking stick.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Rammohun Roy as a dignified early 19th-century Bengali reformer: a thoughtful middle-aged man of medium height with an oval wheatish-brown face, straight nose, small round spectacles and a neat moustache with short beard along the jawline, his expression calm and intellectually intense. His black hair is tucked under a deep blue silk Bengali-style turban with a slightly conical crown and a narrow gold border. He wears a finely pleated white cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles and an off-white long-sleeved jama crossing and tying at the waist, its edges trimmed with a thin gold border, with a full-length sleeveless dark indigo shawl draped from the left shoulder across his body and around his back, the ends hanging neatly with a subtle lighter-blue stripe pattern. His feet are in simple brown leather slippers and he has a plain signet ring on his right hand. In his right hand he firmly holds a rolled manuscript tied with a red ribbon, while his left hand rests on a plain wooden walking stick; show him front-facing and in three-quarter view in the same outfit and colours so the turban, shawl, dhoti, jama, manuscript and stick can be consistently redrawn.
